children.value: > Fact From Story: Ford is delaying about $12 billion in planned investments on EVs, including construction of a second battery plant with joint venture partner SK On due to softening demand for higher-priced premium electric vehicles.
> > Fact From Story: That price pressure has squeezed profits, and in the case of Ford’s EV business caused losses to grow.
> > Fact From Story: While EV sales have grown, consumers aren’t willing to pay a premium for an EV over a gas or hybrid vehicle.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies will often delay or reduce investments in areas where they are experiencing losses or reduced profits.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a company is delaying investments, it is likely due to a change in market conditions or internal priorities.
